business_problem: Storebrand Bank needed to accelerate lending and other customer-facing banking processes while coping with rising operational volume, but its automation work was fragmented across silos and too dependent on manual effort.
solution_summary: Cognizant and Storebrand Bank turned a siloed automation effort into a dedicated Automation-as-a-Service operating model for banking operations. A multi-skilled POD team prioritized the automation pipeline, then moved early attended automations to unattended workflows orchestrated through UiPath Automation Cloud so routine jobs could run continuously without manual triggering. For document-heavy steps, Cognizant integrated a third-party generative AI service that extracts unstructured information from incoming documents and passes structured values to bots for downstream processing. Manual approval checkpoints stay inside the workflow when a human decision is required, and KPI dashboards measure cycle-time and efficiency gains across the automation portfolio. The result is a scalable framework that combines document AI, RPA, human validation and SLA-backed support to accelerate credit-card approvals, loan establishment and other consumer-banking processes.

data_flow: Applications and supporting documents enter Storebrand Bank workflows, where a third-party generative AI service extracts key information from unstructured files and passes structured values into unattended UiPath-orchestrated bots. The workflows include human validation when approvals are required, while KPI dashboards capture cycle-time and savings data across the automation portfolio.
business_outcome: Storebrand Bank shortened customer-value delivery times, scaled automation across back-office and front-office work, and created a 24/7 operating model that supports faster approvals and more consistent service.
metrics: 10 minutes off every credit card application

Manual approval stages remain in the automation chain where a human must validate the result.
The bank moved from project delivery to an SLA-backed Automation-as-a-Service model.
